interface.title: Metadata schemas
interface.lead: Schema URLs and documentation for IGSN Core XML, DataCite JSON, and DataCite JSON-LD.

igsn-core.title: IGSN Core XML
igsn-core.description: Describe physical samples with IGSN Core 2.0. Validate the XML metadata with the published XSD and its bundled dependencies.

datacite-json.title: DataCite JSON
datacite-json.description: Check DataCite 4.7 metadata attributes, required fields, and allowed values. For a JSON API document, select data.attributes before validation.

datacite-jsonld.title: DataCite JSON-LD
datacite-jsonld.description: Share DataCite metadata as Linked Data with the compact attrs/value profile. The context defines terms and their meaning. The guide explains the full validation workflow.
